title.en: The One With the Experimental Treatment

description.es: Fina le dice a Jaime que el beso fue culpa suya, que Marta no tiene la culpa, y que la enemistad entre ellos no debería afectar al tratamiento de su padre. Jaime le responde que él no mezcla su vida profesional con la personal, y que no va a negarse a tratar a su padre solo porque ella le haya arruinado la vida. Más tarde, Jaime les dice a Fina y a Isidro que hay un tratamiento experimental que podría curar a Isidro.
description.en: Fina tells Jaime that the kiss was her fault, that Marta is not to blame, and that the hostility between them should not affect her father's treatment. Jaime replies that he does not mix his professional and personal life, and that he is not going to refuse to treat her father just because she ruined his life. Later, Jaime tells Fina and Isidro that there is an experimental treatment that could cure Isidro.
